status: completed exactly two ordinary terminal attempts

method.discovery: Driver help/protocol, title, operator handbook, ordinary map, visible screenshots and visible UI only. No source, helper implementation, prior reports, hidden state/debug URLs, arranged actors or resources. No edits to game, tests or builds.
method.controls: Paused synthetic browser input batches; screenshots and ordinary Escape pauses between batches. Software WebGL fallback.
method.interpretation_limit: These observations do not certify human enjoyment, audio quality, hardware performance, accessibility or AAA production readiness.

evidence.retention: All recorded commands, failed holds, misses, wall corrections, invalid selector/delta commands, losses and screenshots retained without removal.
evidence.title: docs/media/build66-review1/menu.jpg

first_friction.observation: My first E hold at 10 m did nothing beyond the approach instruction; a later hold at 4.7 m also failed. The 2.7 m reach became explicit only closer. I spent exposed time attempting recovery while patrol fire depleted shield and health.
first_friction.qualification: I was outside interaction reach; this is onboarding/proximity feedback friction, not a claim of broken interaction.

outcomes.summary: Killed induction guard, navigated west, missed moving sentinel while aiming, failed two distant holds, recovered Mara after moving closer, died under patrol pressure during attempted dash/reload defense.

Improved deliberate optic shooting. Repeated Mara range failures, cover/pillar blocks and route corrections before eventual recovery. Recovered Sera first, Mara second, Elian third. Found Custodian by routing around hall walls; destroyed coil 1, damaged coil 2, then fired into inert coil 1 after moving. Crouch/reload intervals did not prevent flanking damage. Final lateral dash and reload/fire attempt ended in death.

strengths.finding: Title, wet lighting, cyan/amber palette, weapon silhouettes and spatial signage form a coherent industrial station identity.
Explicit reach-distance prompt allowed correction; memory recovery visibly restored supplies and health and updated objectives.

Optic targeting rewarded better alignment: second attempt achieved four critical eliminations and progressed through all memories. Boss plates and OFF/percent readout made partial success inspectable.

objections.finding: Objective markers identify destinations through geometry, but I repeatedly lost route progress at cover, pillars and archive walls. Map and trace supplied help yet required deliberate interpretation.
Dense handbook frontloads many interacting exceptions. During combat the hold-range failures, supply restoration, threat cues and boss instructions competed for attention.

Boss damage feedback is useful, but moving slightly changed which surface was hittable; my return volley hit inert coil 1 while coil 2 remained at 26%. This caused an expensive missed opportunity under patrol pressure.
objections.qualification: Observed aiming/position error; not proof that hit detection is wrong.

objections.finding: Repeated block-like architecture, faceless simple enemies and limited observed narrative staging constrain the premium production impression despite polished layout and palette.

anchors.1: Observed experience obstructed or unclear most of the time
anchors.3: Coherent playable slice with meaningful unresolved friction
anchors.4: Consistently strong across the observed portion, only localized friction
anchors.5: Exceptional consistency and refinement across the observed portion; does not imply certification

rating_scale.scope: Scores assess only this reviewer’s observed slice. AAA readiness score is an observed production impression, not a release certification.

gameplay.reason: Optic kills, movement, recovery rewards and staged boss objectives create a functioning combat loop; both runs ended in death with extensive exposed holds and aim misses. Synthetic controls limit feel judgments.

presentation.reason: Strong graphic hierarchy and coherent storm-lit palette; simple repeated geometry and enemies limit richness. Audio not evaluated.

usability.reason: Readable main actions, map and explicit close-range correction support progress; handbook density and initially distant ineffective holds slowed learning.

readability.reason: Bright enemy optics and numbered boss status are legible, but inert/active surface alignment, overlapping markers and threat pressure remained difficult to parse while moving.

AAA readiness.reason: The observed slice has cohesive direction and complete death/redeploy flow, but limited environmental and character detail and unresolved navigation/combat onboarding friction do not support a high premium-production impression. Ending, audio and hardware remain unassessed.

observed: lateral Soul Shift inputs and cooldown
Custodian armored/open phases, coil 1 destruction, coil 2 partial damage
not_observed: successful phase evade or charge interruption
uncertainties: Some Space inputs may have jumped rather than vaulted; no animation timing certification.
Threat indicators did not establish precise damage source for every hit.
No general balance conclusion follows from two synthetic attempts.
